Name: Natural Dark Wood Interface - Generic Mod Config Menu Recolor
Author: fulg3nn
Description:
Hey! As you may know, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] includes new buttons that may not match with the custom UI you have installed, so i decided to edit it, so it can match with my favorite UI Mod: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20684]Natural Dark Wood Interface[/url]. :)

[b]How to install:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Instal the Generic Mod Config Menu Mod, unzip it, and drag it into your mods folder[/size][size=2] (C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)[/size]
[*][size=3]Download the .zip file, it contains two .png files.[/size]
[*]Enter the "GenericModConfigMenu folder", then the "assets" folder, and replace those 2 .png files with my files of the same name :)).
[*]Done!
[/list][size=3]
Have a great day! <3
[/size]
